skill_concept: Generate a self-signed SSL certificate with openssl and configure a server (nginx or Jupyter) to terminate HTTPS by referencing the cert and key in the server's config file, then restart the service.
verdict_reason: Both tasks use openssl to generate a self-signed cert and wire it into a server config, so the core SSL generation procedure transfers directly. However, home-server-https adds substantial non-SSL work (ddclient dynamic DNS, acme.sh directory conventions, nginx site config) that makes the skill only partially applicable, and the two servers (nginx vs Jupyter) have meaningfully different config mechanisms.
weakest_link_reason: This task requires configuring dynamic DNS with ddclient and navigating acme.sh path conventions on top of the SSL/nginx steps, which go well beyond the candidate skill's defined scope.
